selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the load-bearing method gap because it asks for a faithful, low-cost object on the user's actual task rather than another cross-task predictor. Reframe as a solvable object closes it by defining a source-anchored, dependency-relative locally irreducible subset whose correctness is gated by a beneficial full artifact and certified by direct paired effect equivalence.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under the shared_object thread, the same task-local certificate reads the full artifact, candidate slice, baseline, guardrails, and measured resource terms, so effect preservation and net-benefit accounting are not separate modules. Reframe as a solvable object closes this gap by making cost- and regression-adjusted paired effect, contract validity, and guardrail noninferiority simultaneous constraints of one certified subset.

deliverable_coverage: method - both gaps share reframe_as_solvable_object, which yields the runnable eligibility gate, source-grounded subset worker, and sealed task-local effect-preservation certificate.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: the method conditions on an independently locked task and does not infer that task's representativeness for any wider distribution.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: certificates remain task-local and are never pooled into a cross-paper predictor, ranking, or calibration model.
